html.en: Delivered an invited talk at the Google Deepmind Diffusion Reading Group titiled A Path to Human-preferred One-step Text-to-image Generative Models . Check the [Slides] here.
html.zh: 受邀在 Google DeepMind 扩散模型读书会作报告：迈向符合人类偏好的一步文生图模型。报告幻灯片见 [Slides]。

html.en: Be invited to give an (internal) online academic talk in the Google Deepmind research team on 12th Nov. The talk title is One-step Text-to-image Generative Models: from Diffusion Distillation to Human-preference Alignment . In this talk, I will share some exciting progress in improving human preferences for one-step and few-step text-to-image generative models through the lens of Reinforcement Learning using Human Feedback (RLHF). Readers can refer to Diff-Insruct++ and Diff-Insruct* for technical details.
html.zh: 受邀于 11 月 12 日为 Google DeepMind 研究团队作线上内部学术报告，主题为一步文生图模型：从扩散蒸馏到人类偏好对齐。报告将从人类反馈强化学习（RLHF）的角度，介绍提升一步与少步文生图模型人类偏好的研究进展。技术细节可参见 Diff-Insruct++ 与 Diff-Insruct*。

html.en: An invited talk delivered at the Biomedical Engineering lab led by Dr. Sun at Peking University, Beijing, China. The talk is on Recent Progresses on Diffusion Distillation .
html.zh: 在北京大学 Dr. Sun 带领的生物医学工程实验室作受邀报告，主题为扩散模型蒸馏的近期进展。

html.en: Had an academic visit to MAPLE lab led by Dr. Qi in Westlake University, Hangzhou, China. Delivered a talk on Efficient Generative Models to lab members.
html.zh: 访问位于杭州的西湖大学 Dr. Qi 带领的 MAPLE 实验室，并向实验室成员作高效生成式模型报告。
